Impact Absorption Quirk.name: Impact Absorption Quirk
Impact Absorption Quirk.description:
🥊 Your body soaks up impacts and stores their force.

🌱 At the start you go soft as a blow lands, taking a punch, a bat swing or a fall from a second-floor window unhurt, then send what you stored back out in one hard blow.
📈 With training: people shielded, a swallowed arm, rooftop bounces, knives and bullets stopped, a room knocked flat, a fight's force returned, a truck stopped.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as holding the soft state burns through your body's reserves.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Fat Gum (Fat Absorption).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Blocking +5, Health +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Sinking Guard, Payback Blow
🛡️ Resists: bludgeoning
Impact Absorption Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: while active, the body turns soft and dense; a blow that sinks in is stored as force, not felt. A new adult user takes a strong adult's punch, a bat swing or a second-floor fall unhurt, holds it about a minute, releasing it in one contact blow. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only blunt force sinks in; blades and bullets still cut at the start; heat, cold, electricity, sound and gas pass through. Grabs, chokes and unseen blows get no help. Stored force cannot be split or thrown; no sprinting or dodging while soft. A growing flush and tremor warn sharp foes the user is loaded. Quirk Strain: light: soak or release a blow; moderate: shield people, hold an attacker, rebound; heavy: catch blades and bullets, shake the ground; severe: signature release, stopping a vehicle dead. Type: Transformation. Law: soaking blows is self-defense; unlicensed release of stored force into a person is assault. Look: the body thickens by half; struck spots dent and refill.
